title: Tensor-to-ordinary pullback comparison respects composition on homotopy single complexes
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y\to Z$ be scheme morphisms [def-pc-scheme], and let $N$ be a sheaf of $\mathcal O_Z$-modules [def-pc-module-pullback]. Assume the tensor pullbacks $T_f,T_g,T_{f\gg g}$ are additive. Let $a_b$ be the selected adjunction $T_b\dashv b_*$ [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], and let $t_b:T_b\cong b^*$ be its unique comparison with the ordinary pullback-pushforward adjunction. On homotopy categories write $S_X(M)=M[0]$ and $Q_X$ for the quotient from complexes to the homotopy category. Set $r_b(M)=Q_X(\operatorname{singleMapHomologicalComplex}(T_b)_M)\gg S_X(t_b(M).\mathrm{hom})$. Let $c:T_g\mathbin{\ggg}T_f\cong T_{f\gg g}$ be the adjunction conjugate of the inverse of the pushforward composition isomorphism. Then, with $E=S_Z(N)$ and with $c^h$ its termwise homotopy lift, $c^h(E).\mathrm{hom}\gg r_{f\gg g}(N)=T_f^h(r_g(N))\gg r_f(g^*N)\gg S_X(\operatorname{pullbackComp}(f,g).\mathrm{hom}_N)$. No flatness or nonemptiness hypothesis is required.

proof.text: For any two adjunctions with the same right adjoint, conjugateEquiv sends the hom of leftAdjointUniq to the identity. This follows by unfolding leftAdjointUniq and applying conjugateIsoEquiv_symm_apply_inv. For three composable adjunctions, use conjugateEquiv_comp and its two whiskering formulas. The conjugate of ordinary pullbackComp.hom is pushforwardComp.inv, by conjugateEquiv_pullbackComp_inv and the inverse law. Thus both paths from the composite tensor pullback to ordinary composite pullback have the same conjugate. Injectivity gives whiskerRight(t_g,T_f) followed by whiskerLeft(g*,t_f), then pullbackComp.hom, equal to c.hom followed by t_(f≫g).

Apply HomologicalComplex.to_single_hom_ext to the two induced maps into the single complex. At degree zero, unfolding singleMapHomologicalComplex and mapHomologicalComplexCompIso reduces the equation to the component at N of the natural transformation identity in step 1. Functoriality and naturality identify the two paths. The other degrees are disposed of by to_single_hom_ext, since the target is supported at zero.

Map this chain-map identity through the homotopy quotient. Expand mapHomotopyCategoryCompIso and singleFunctor, then use quotient lift component formulas and map_comp. This is exactly the claimed equality, without inverting any single comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem homotopySinglePullbackComposition
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (N : Z.Modules)
    [(tensorPullback f).Additive] [(tensorPullback g).Additive]
    [(tensorPullback (f ≫ g)).Additive] :
    let t_f := (Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction f)).leftAdjointUniq
      (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f)
    let t_g := (Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction g)).leftAdjointUniq
      (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g)
    let t_fg := (Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (f ≫ g))).leftAdjointUniq
      (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (f ≫ g))
    let r_f := (HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map
      ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex
        (tensorPullback f) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).hom.app ((pullback g).obj N)) ≫
      (HomotopyCategory.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).map
        (t_f.hom.app ((pullback g).obj N))
    let r_g := (HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map
      ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex
        (tensorPullback g) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).hom.app N) ≫
      (HomotopyCategory.singleFunctor Y.Modules 0).map (t_g.hom.app N)
    let r_fg := (HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map
      ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex
        (tensorPullback (f ≫ g)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).hom.app N) ≫
      (HomotopyCategory.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).map (t_fg.hom.app N)
    (Functor.mapHomotopyCategoryCompIso
      ((conjugateIsoEquiv
        (Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (f ≫ g)))
        ((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction g)).comp
          (Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction f)))).symm
        (pushforwardComp f g).symm)
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).hom.app
        ((HomotopyCategory.singleFunctor Z.Modules 0).obj N) ≫ r_fg =
    ((tensorPullback f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map r_g ≫ r_f ≫
      (HomotopyCategory.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).map
        ((pullbackComp f g).hom.app N)
